models.name: Jev
models.note: Jev 1.14.0 adds experimental images and Box. At review, latest resolves to 1.13.0 and preview to 1.14.0; aliases can change.

models.name: decision-machine-1
models.note: Use its TypeSafe-compatible endpoint. Native extraction and image endpoints are separate.

models.name: Jev through OpenRouter
models.note: OpenRouter-reported USD cost is supported.

models.name: Jev through Vercel AI Gateway
models.note: Use the /typesafe-compatible endpoint with TypeSafe model naming. The gateway /v1/evaluate surface has a separate contract.

models.name: Laya
models.note: English, multilingual and typed-decisions checkpoints; start your server separately.

models.name: Kev
models.note: The loaded checkpoint determines which model is served.

models.name: Decider
models.note: Use /v1/systemone; the separate /decide schema has different semantics.

models.name: Bespoke Nimble
models.note: The serving wrapper supports two to 26 rubric levels.

models.name: Von
models.note: Inspect truncation metadata retained in response extensions.

models.name: OpenJev (DiffusionGemma)
models.note: Text and image decisions; single-level scores and structured legends are supported.

models.name: Open models through Codiv
models.note: Hosted open models require a Codiv bearer key.

models.name: Open-Jev (Zefan Cai)
models.note: Independent 2B, 9B and 27B family; use its System One route.

models.name: Reflex
models.note: Single-pass typed decisions, including optional vision inputs.

models.name: JevK5
models.note: Use its compatible server or Codiv jevk5-0.2. Score legends are not reported and remain unknown.

models.name: OpenThai-SystemOne
models.note: Thai and English checkpoint.

models.name: Jeff (GliFormer)
models.note: Supports single-level scores and JSON legends.

models.name: Rizzo Flow
models.note: Use its System One route; /v1/decisions is separate.

models.name: Ollaya
models.note: Local runtime for Laya, Decider and NLI models; model names depend on pulled artifacts.

models.name: EdgeJev
models.note: ONNX runtime; use the model name configured on the server.

models.name: OpenJev on SGLang
models.note: Independent runtime for compatible prefill models; no guarantee that every checkpoint works.

models.name: SemIf (formerly OpenJev)
models.note: CLI/library option probabilities need mapping to named System One answers.

models.name: Tev1
models.note: Together answer letters and logprobs need mapping. A selected letter alone is not a full distribution.

models.name: NanoJev
models.note: Custom /api/evaluate batches need mapping; boolean becomes Noul, not a thresholded label.

models.name: AgentJev
models.note: Custom /api/evaluate lists need mapping by question ID.

models.name: AnyJev
models.note: Map library distributions and p_true. Numeric bin-center scores require an explicit ordinal mapping.

models.name: Verdict
models.note: Library/browser results need mapping; Codiv also serves verdict-1.4.

models.name: Valen
models.note: Multimodal library outputs need mapping to named typed answers.

models.name: Eikos
models.note: System One server for finance. Score is a most-likely level; its separate expected field is preserved. Session routes are separate.

models.name: dev-0.4b
models.note: ModernBERT decision library outputs need mapping.

models.name: Blink
models.note: Embedded C/Wasm outputs need mapping; static demo hosting is not an inference endpoint.

models.name: Jev-Omni
models.note: Single-question Python classifier, distinct from both OmniJev projects. Offline --dialect jev-omni requires exact ordered option IDs. Observer inspects2–255 options; native256 is explicitly rejected by the converter.

models.name: AutoTrust JEV
models.note: Custom /v1/decide uses ordered probability arrays; map options explicitly.

models.name: NeoHorse-Jev
models.note: Map the bundled runtime response; serving adapters differ by backend.

models.name: MATILDA-jev
models.note: Bundled System One runtime supports optional images.

models.name: Jev-Style GGUF
models.note: LM Studio/llama.cpp logprobs need explicit option mapping; truncated top_logprobs is not a full distribution.

models.name: Intern-Decision
models.note: Map distributions over original option values; confidence means maximum probability.

models.name: FRIDA-Decisions
models.note: Russian decision model; vLLM /pooling wrapper requires result mapping. Ranking is outside typed decision views.

models.name: vLLM Semantic Router Decision models
models.note: Decision 1.0/2.0 library outputs need mapping; routing outcomes remain application actions.

models.name: OneJev 1.6 (OmniJev organization)
models.note: qev server; choose the port and loaded checkpoint you started. Six-decimal results and one-level Scores. New TypeSafe SDK clients need compression disabled for the reviewed qev JSON parser.

models.name: OmniJev v1.1 (older MSO library)
models.note: Distinct from OneJev. Offline --dialect omnijev preserves abstention and modal Score. Abstaining/invalid results remain invalid; no mass renormalization.255 levels is an Observer inspection bound, not an upstream limit.

models.name: Cloudflare Clef native helpers
models.note: Saved native helper results use System One capture import. Four-decimal output;255 choices/levels is the Observer inspection bound, not a documented native maximum. Runtime wrappers have separate profiles.

models.name: Clef through Cloudflare Workers AI
models.note: Replace ACCOUNT_ID. Bearer API token; select cloudflare-systemone to unwrap REST result/success. Worker bindings return a different outer envelope. Native helper precision is reviewed; no authenticated REST inference was performed.

models.name: Ollama System One runtime
models.note: Use the model actually pulled. Reviewed local generic renderer:2–26 choices and2–10 Score levels; no four-decimal rounding imposed. Model-specific runtime entries differ. Requires Ollama 0.35.0 or later.

models.name: Clef through local Ollama
models.note: Local Clef renderer allows 2–26 choices / 2–10 Scores and preserves float precision. Cloud Clef has a different limit. Requires 0.35.1 or later; not a claim about every GGUF serializer.

models.name: Kev through Ollama
models.note: Reviewed Kev renderer uses one to 255 options/levels, optional instructions and four-decimal output; choose a loaded Kev checkpoint.

models.name: Liquid d1 / d1-ultra hosted
models.note: Bearer Liquid API key. SDK compression must be disabled for this documented endpoint. Undocumented cardinality/serialization details retain strict Observer defaults; image HTTP extensions differ from SDK inputs.

models.name: Liquid d1-3B library
models.note: Save the original system_one request and answers/usage result; its library response has no model field. Preserve caller request model and batch identity. Other serving wrappers are separate contracts.

models.name: Liquid d1-omni-600M library
models.note: Saved Python invocation: text/images or audio, not images and audio together. Stringified legends and full probabilities; no native HTTP server inferred from model weights.

models.name: Microsoft Decision1 on Foundry
models.note: Replace resource and deployment. Use an Entra Bearer token with the proxy; native api-key authentication is a separate header path. Request deployment and returned underlying model names differ. No undocumented Score cap or precision inferred.

models.name: H2O Lightning 4B
models.note: Reviewed 1.3.1 shim supports 1–255 levels and Box. No localization returns full-frame/confidence 0/found:false; this alone does not prove target absence; preserve found/present. This is distinct from its OpenAI-style /v1/decisions adapter and GGUF runtime.

models.name: Strands Decider
models.note: Start the reviewed server separately.2–255 choices / 2–10 Score levels; four-decimal output and nullable Noul criteria. Default checkpoint is text-only; vision engines require separate setup.

models.name: Perplexity Decider v1.1
models.note: Reviewed v1.1 server: 1–255 choices / 2–10 Score levels, optional instructions and at most 4 image inputs. Its serialization precision was not inferred from v1.2 or an Ollama wrapper.

models.name: Perplexity Decider v1.2 library
models.note: Joint-context Decider.decide library has 1–255 choices / 2–255 Scores; preserve the complete original request and sequence usage. No native HTTP server claimed; v1.1/Ollama rendering is not interchangeable.

models.name: OpenAI Decisions
models.note: OpenAI native Decisions protocol; use the original choices/levels schema. Model names are source-reviewed suggestions, not an account availability check. HTTP reference says 1–400 questions; pinned SDK docstring says 1–200. No undocumented Score-level bound is claimed.

review_scope: Incremental source review; each entry retains its own checked_at date. No live model inference for these additions.
